item.title: The Best Time to Visit Sedona? October Makes a Strong Case
item.description: Fall in Sedona means 70-degree afternoons, gold cottonwoods along Oak Creek, harvest in the Verde Valley vineyards and thinner crowds on the trails. Here's how to plan an October or November visit — hikes, wine, where to stay and what to book early.

item.title: Sedona in November: Weather, Crowds, Fall Color and What to Do
item.description: Planning Sedona in November? Here's the real weather, where fall color lingers, 2026 event dates, park fees and hours, and how we'd spend the days.
